remarks: Elegant Amherst Estate with Scenic Pond Views Welcome to this beautifully appointed estate-style home located at 400 Tiburon Lane in Amherst, offering the perfect blend of comfort, space, and sophistication. Boasting 2,400 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence is ideal for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. The home features a dramatic family room with vaulted ceilings and a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and inviting focal point. The beautifully updated kitchen offers ample cabinetry and workspace, flowing seamlessly into the main living areas—perfect for hosting family and guests. Retreat to the spacious primary suite, complete with generous closet space and a private en-suite bath. Additional bedrooms are well-sized and filled with natural light. The finished basement provides valuable bonus space, ideal for a home theater, gym, office, or recreation room. Step outside to your private deck overlooking a serene pond, offering peaceful views and the perfect setting for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Additional highlights include a 2.5-car attached garage, central air, and a quiet, well-maintained neighborhood setting. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and top-rated Amherst schools, this exceptional property delivers luxury, privacy, and lifestyle in one of Western New York’s most desirable areas.
